tickerText: [TENNIS] US Open Day 1 — Djokovic stunned by Navone in five sets, ending a 78-match Grand Slam first-round streak; Pegula cruises past Ruse, Medvedev beats Gaston; rain halts outside courts at Flushing Meadows • [SQUASH] World Squash Masters Day 2 in Perth — Heather Manifold claims first women's win on the all-glass court in Women's 60+; 900+ players across 21 age groups at Karrinyup • [BADMINTON] Pontianak International Challenge finals — India's Tanvi Patri (15) and Ginpaul Sonna reach championship matches after upsetting seeded opponents in Indonesia • [PICKLEBALL] New Jersey 5s win first MLP title — 2-0 sweep of St. Louis Shock at Central Park; Staksrud named Finals MVP after 21-9 DreamBreaker clincher • [TABLE TENNIS] HYLO ETTU Champions League Stage 1 concludes — Linz AG Froschberg goes 3-0 in Budaörs women; HB Ostrov perfect in Lille men's Group A

newsItems.title: Djokovic Stunned in US Open Opener
newsItems.excerpt: Novak Djokovic lost a five-set first-round thriller to Mariano Navone on Arthur Ashe, ending a 78-match Grand Slam first-round win streak while visibly battling illness through the four-hour marathon.

newsItems.title: Indian Teens Star in Pontianak
newsItems.excerpt: 15-year-old Tanvi Patri beat world No. 51 Rachel Chan to reach the Pontianak International Challenge final, while Ginpaul Sonna upset former world No. 15 Chico Aura Dwi Wardoyo in the men's semis.

newsItems.title: NJ 5s Finally Win MLP Crown
newsItems.excerpt: After two straight runner-up finishes, the New Jersey 5s swept St. Louis Shock 2-0 at Central Park — Anna Leigh Waters earned her first MLP title and Federico Staksrud was named Finals MVP.

newsItems.title: ETTU Stage 1 Qualifiers Set
newsItems.excerpt: Linz AG Froschberg completed a perfect Group A run at the ETTU Champions League Women in Budaörs, while HB Ostrov and ASD TT Santa Tecla Nulvi secured men's berths from Lille.
